plan.selection: none; no model, interval method or warning rule is selected, locked or deployed here

point_candidates.persistence: AQI of the 24 h ending at the 17:00 cutoff (reference)
point_candidates.ridge_weather_same_rows: paper Weather Ridge refitted on history-available rows (reference)
point_candidates.ridge_persistence_residual: Ridge on target minus persistence; shrinks toward persistence, not the mean
point_candidates.lgbm_tail_weighted: LightGBM, sample weight 1 + observed category index
point_candidates.lgbm_censored_floor: LightGBM trained with censored Severe days at their 401 lower bound (biased low by construction)
point_candidates.max_persistence_ridge: maximum of persistence and History Ridge (threshold-aware heuristic)

plan.interval_note: outcomes of day D-1 are incomplete at the 20:00 issue on D-1, so recalibration uses dates up to D-2
plan.survivorship_cohort: stations with at least 30 valid targets in the first fold training window, fixed for all folds
plan.final_test: SEALED; rows filtered by date before materialisation

warnings.default_policy: NONE SELECTED: no cost ratio between a missed category and an excess alert has been declared

survivorship.frozen_rule: stations with at least 30 valid targets in the first fold training window, fixed for all folds

catalogue_exposure.basis: OpenAQ catalogue first/last timestamps; no pollutant value read; dropped monitors were never downloaded

survivorship.limit: Monitors that stopped reporting before the recent-activity cutoff were never downloaded, so this analysis removes late entrants but cannot add back lost monitors; catalogue_exposure counts them.
